enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Sleep. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Place arm under pillow. Turn to right side. Move leg. Pull blanket up. Breathe regularly. Remain still. Turn to back. Open eyes at 06:30. Sit up on bed. Swing legs over edge. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up and getting ready for the day
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off tap. Wash face with water. Dry face with towel. Turn on tap. Wash hands with soap. Rinse hands. Turn off tap. Dry hands with towel. Comb hair. Apply deodorant. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out milk and eggs. Close refrigerator. Take out bowl and pan from cabinet. Place pan on stove. Turn on stove. Crack eggs into bowl. Beat eggs with fork. Pour eggs into pan. Cook eggs. Turn off stove. Place eggs on plate. Place bread in toaster. Press toaster lever. Remove toast. Spread butter on toast. Pour milk into glass. Sit at table. Eat breakfast and drink milk.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open closet. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Take out socks. Take out shoes. Close closet. Take off pajamas. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Walk to mirror. Check appearance. Adjust shirt collar. Pick up bag. Walk out of bedroom.

Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Bus arrives. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Bus stops. Stand up. Walk to exit. Get off bus. Walk to workplace. Enter building. Walk to locker room.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Arrive at workstation. Put on lab coat. Turn on computer. Log in. Review patient charts. Walk to patient room. Greet patient. Check vital signs. Measure blood pressure. Record data. Administer medication. Walk to nurses' station. Update records. Answer phone. Talk to colleague. Walk to next patient. Check patient's condition. Adjust IV drip. Talk to patient. Walk back to station.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break and eating
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to cafeteria. Get tray. Pick up food. Pay for food. Find table. Sit down. Eat lunch. Talk to colleagues. Drink water. Stand up. Return tray. Walk outside. Walk back to department.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Return to workstation. Check messages. Review new patients. Walk to patient room. Take vitals. Administer treatment. Talk to patient. Update charts. Attend meeting. Discuss cases. Walk to lab. Collect samples. Return to station. Answer calls. Prepare reports.
Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Check phone. Look out window. Bus stops. Stand up. Get off bus. Walk home. Enter home.

Walk into kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out ingredients. Close refrigerator. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Add oil. Add meat. Stir. Add vegetables. Cook. Turn off stove. Place food on plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Stand up. Place plate in sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing and watching TV, using fan due to heat
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Turn on TV. Turn on fan. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Change channel. Watch TV. Adjust fan speed. Watch TV. Stand up. Stretch. Sit down. Watch TV. Turn off TV. Turn off fan. Walk to bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Using computer and phone for leisure
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Open laptop. Log in. Open browser. Browse internet. Pick up phone. Check messages. Use social media. Put down phone. Continue computer. Watch video. Adjust chair. Stand up. Walk to bathroom.

Walk into bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Turn on shower. Adjust temperature. Take off clothes. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Wash body. Rinse. Apply shampoo. Wash hair. Rinse. Turn off shower. Step out. Dry with towel. Put on clothes. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading and winding down, using fan
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Turn on fan. Pick up book. Sit on bed. Open book. Read. Turn page. Read. Turn page. Close book. Place book on nightstand. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Lie down. Close eyes.
Lie down. Pull blanket. Close eyes. Sleep. Turn to left. Adjust pillow. Turn to right. Move arm. Breathe. Remain still. Turn to back. Sleep.
